My installations

A few seasons on the stoop

Planters, stoops and arrangements I've designed, from Easter bunnies to Red October.

Seasonal installations

Four installs a year, each one made for the season

I mix live plants with long-lasting faux florals and décor, so every display looks full and fresh all season. Each install includes the design, setup, and removal of the last season's display.

Installs March – April

Spring

  • Live pansies, violas & ranunculus
  • Faux roses, peonies & tulips
  • Moss bunnies, eggs & pussy willow
Installs mid-May – June

Summer

  • Live zinnias, geraniums & trailing vines
  • Faux florals for hot or shady spots
  • Flags & Fourth of July accents
Installs mid-Sept – Oct

Fall

  • Live mums & ornamental kale
  • Heirloom pumpkins, gourds & branches
  • Halloween & Thanksgiving themes
Installs late Nov – Dec

Holiday & winter

  • Fresh or faux evergreens & mini trees
  • Candy canes, bows & berries
  • Garland, wreaths & lights

About me

Hi, I'm Shirah gardener & decorator

I'm a Philadelphia gardener and a member of the Pennsylvania Horticultural Society. I've attended the Philadelphia Flower Show every year since 2023 and volunteered there in 2024. I started The Upside Philly to bring that love of plants to the front of the house, where the whole block can enjoy it.

Every window box and seasonal display I create is designed for your building, your light and your style. I'm the one who plants it, styles it and comes back each season to refresh it.

PHS memberPhiladelphia Flower Show volunteer, 2024Based in Philadelphia
